entries.description: For each tool, the first line of every rendered role file is ---, and its frontmatter parses with name and description set.
Read-only roles render with readonly: true for Cursor, and with no Edit, Write or Bash tools for Claude Code.
Both checker roles exist with frontmatter name, description, tier deep and tools read, and both render for Cursor and Claude.
Severity category check-weakened is P0 in harness.yaml.
A fixture diff that deletes a test makes the integrity-checker prompt fixture expect check-weakened.
